inclusion_rule: Human studies that decode speech content (phonemes, syllables, words, sentences, acoustics or speech activity) from intracranial recordings (ECoG, sEEG, depth or intracortical electrodes) during produced, attempted, imagined or perceived speech; design of interest: how the decoder turns a continuous neural time series into an output sequence: closed-set classification of segmented trials, regression to acoustics, or ASR-style search (HMM/Viterbi over frame likelihoods with an n-gram language model); secondary: whether the feature vector spans several time lags. Boundary: reviews, mapping or encoding studies without a decoder, off-task decoders and scalp-EEG papers matched by the ledger pattern are removed from the population; versions and repeated reports of one experiment count once; usual approach judged on studies first public before 2016-02.
